text: We hire curious builders who learn quickly, adapt to unfamiliar problems and share what they discover.
People take ownership of outcomes and act with autonomy instead of waiting for permission.
Candidates should have five years of experience with Python, SQL and cloud infrastructure.
Managers define tasks and review delivery against a detailed operating plan.
Small teams own customer problems from discovery through delivery and can change the plan when evidence changes.
We value fast learners who are comfortable making progress before every detail is known.
